endpointName: Marge Cline Whitewater Course take-out / downstream portage

evidence.cityFacility: Yorkville identifies the course as free and open-use, with a boat launch at the east end and portage points at both ends.
evidence.downstreamPortage: The city identifies a designated canoe portage west of Route 47 on the south bank next to the Parks and Recreation building.
evidence.coordinateFit: The stored point is retained as the downstream portage/course facility anchor. Its 480-foot connected-network offset and 196-foot mapped-water distance reflect the bypass-course facility layout, not a wrong Fox River location.
